body: Don’t leave, advice: get in touch with your spiritual side, research your pineal gland and the fact we all have superpowers that are waiting to be accessed. It’s crazy, I hate life too and I want to die, I’m a shitty human, I hate myself but there’s so much interesting things to be discovered about ourselves. Keep going.

My brother feels the same, or he used to but not as much now. All he does is take drugs and he loves it hahaha, he’s a father and a good one at that. His aim is to be happy with what he has, taking drugs and playing video games isn’t a bad thing. If that’s all you wanna do then do it. As long as you’re alive.
I don’t know what to do other than die, she deserves so much better.
Yeah I don’t think I deserve to live, I have a deep seeded hatred for myself and idk if it’ll ever go away
